mapper.delete: DELETE FROM kb_chunk_stage WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND doc_id = #{docId}
mapper.insert: WITH staged AS ( DELETE FROM kb_chunk_stage WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND doc_id = #{docId} AND attempt_id = CAST(#{attemptId} AS uuid) AND create_time >= statement_timestamp() - interval '24 hours' RETURNING id, tenant_code, doc_id, chunk_no, content, char_count, token_count, embedding, embedding_model ) INSERT INTO kb_chunk (id, tenant_code, doc_id, chunk_no, content, char_count, token_count, embedding, embedding_model) SELECT id, tenant_code, doc_id, chunk_no, content, char_count, token_count, embedding, embedding_model FROM staged
